!NOTE]
>
> All examples in these docs use `mcpjam` directly. If you installed via `npx`,
> replace `mcpjam` with `npx -y @mcpja

m/cli@latest`.

## Command groups

### Local MCP testing

These stay at the program root. They reject `--api-key` / `--api-u
rl` / `--project` — except `test`, which accepts them only to reach MCPJam-hosted inference.\n\n| Group | Purpose | Key commands |
\n| - | - | - |\n| [`test`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/local-evals) | Run an eval suite file locally (BYOK or MCPJam-hosted infer
ence); never uploads | `test <file>` |\n| [`server`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/server-inspection) | Triage connectivity and capa
bilities | `probe`, `doctor`, `info`, `validate`, `ping`, `capabilities`, `export` |\n| [`tools`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/tool
s-resources-prompts) | Exercise the tool surface | `list`, `call` |\n| [`resources`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/tools-resources-p
rompts) | Read resources and templates | `list`, `read`, `templates` |\n| [`prompts`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/tools-resources-
prompts) | Fetch prompts | `list`, `get` |\n| [`subscriptions`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference) | Open a long-lived MCP sub
scription and stream notifications | `listen` |\n| [`tasks`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/tasks) | Drive MCP Tasks and validate the
tasks wire | `list`, `get`, `cancel`, `conformance` |\n| [`events`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/events) | List, poll, watch and s
ubscribe to MCP Events (triggers), and check their conformance | `list`, `poll`, `watch`, `subscribe`, `unsubscribe`, `conformance
` |\n| [`apps`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/apps-conformance) | Validate MCP Apps metadata and resource wiring | `conformance`, `c
onformance-suite` |\n| [`oauth`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/oauth-conformance) | Test OAuth flows and conformance against an MCP
server | `conformance`, `conformance-suite`, `login`, `metadata`, `proxy` |\n| [`protocol`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference)
| MCP protocol conformance checks | `conformance`, `conformance-suite` |\n| [`readiness`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#r
eadiness-hosted-commands) | Grade a server against a publisher's directory. Hosted `start` / `status` / `list` / `cancel` / `repor
t` stay here (leaf `--api-key`; no Cloud project link) | `check`, `start claude`, `start openai`, `start muse`, `status`, `list`,
`cancel`, `report` |\n| [`xaa`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/xaa) | Run the Cross-App Access (ID-JAG) debugger against an MCP serve
r | `run` |\n| [`compat`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#compat-command) | Check whether a server's tools and widgets work
on each AI host | `compat` |\n| [`inspector`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#inspector-commands) | Start, open, or stop the
local Inspector from the CLI | `open`, `start`, `stop` |\n| [`mcp`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/mcp-server) | Run MCPJam as a std
io MCP server for agents (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, ...) | `mcp` |\n| [`telemetry`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/telemet

ry) | Inspect and configure anonymous CLI telemetry | `status`, `disable`, `enable` |

### MCPJam Cloud

Account-bound command
s. Declare `--api-key` / `--api-url` on `mcpjam cloud` (before or after descendants). `mcpjam oauth login` is MCP-server OAuth; `m

cpjam cloud login` is your MCPJam account.

| Group | Purpose | Key commands |
| - | - | - |
| [`cloud`](https://docs.mcpjam.c
om/cli/reference#cloud-workspace) | Account, project link, and workspace | `login`, `logout`, `whoami`, `link`, `status`, `organiz
ations`, `projects`, `sessions` |\n| [`cloud eval`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#cloud-eval-commands) | Author and run ev
al suites in your hosted MCPJam projects | `create`, `list`, `run`, `status` |\n| [`cloud tunnel`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/ref
erence#cloud-tunnel) | Expose a local MCP server through a public MCPJam tunnel URL, registered as a server in your project | `tun
nel --server <name> <url>`, `tunnel --server <name> -- <command>` |\n| [`cloud clients`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#clo
ud-clients-commands) | Manage clients in your hosted MCPJam projects (`cloud hosts` is a deprecated alias) | `list`, `get`, `creat
e`, `update`, `servers`, `duplicate`, `delete`, `templates` |\n| [`cloud environments`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#clou
d-environments-commands) | Manage project environments — the host + servers + pinned skills/plugins bundles eval suites and goals
run against | `list`, `get`, `resolve`, `create`, `update`, `archive`, `restore` |\n| [`cloud images`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli
/reference#cloud-images-commands) | Manage custom Computer sandbox images (blueprints) | `list`, `get`, `create`, `validate`, `edi
t`, `build`, `logs`, `use`, `reset`, `promote`, `delete` |\n| [`cloud skills`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#cloud-skills-
commands) | List and read Cloud Skills in your hosted MCPJam projects — discover the skill IDs that `--compose-skill` and `--skill
` require (read-only; authoring is in the app) | `list`, `get` |\n| [`cloud projects servers`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/referen
ce#cloud-projects-servers-commands) | Connect MCP servers to a project and manage pending connection requests | `connect`, `connec
t-status`, `connect-cancel` |\n\nAlso under `mcpjam cloud`: `goals` (`journeys` is a deprecated alias), `personas`, `swarms`, and
`studies` (which publishes an environment for outside testers and reads what they did; `scenarios` and `user-testing` are deprecat
ed aliases for it). Full flag tables are in the [command reference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference.md).\n\n## Cloud credent
ials and API URL\n\n`--api-key` and `--api-url` are declared on `mcpjam cloud` and work before or after descendants (`mcpjam cloud
--api-key sk_… eval list` and `mcpjam cloud eval list --api-key sk_…` are the same). Local commands, including hosted `readiness`
, reject those flags at the program root. Hosted `readiness` still takes leaf `--api-key`.\n\nCredential precedence for Cloud comm

ands:

1. `--api-key` — must be an `sk_` key. A `mcpjam_…` legacy key is a usage error.
2. `MCPJAM_API_KEY` — same `sk_` rule.
A legacy value in this env var is ignored (with a warning) so SDK eval reporting can still use it.\n3. Stored OAuth from `mcpjam c
loud login`\n4. Missing — Cloud commands fail with login guidance before they hit the network (`mcpjam cloud status` reports `miss

ing` instead)

API URL precedence:

1. `--api-url`
2. `MCPJAM_API_URL`, or `MCPJAM_BASE_URL` (the same server without `/api/v
1`)\n3. The server saved with the OAuth login (only when that login is the credential; a login saved before logins recorded their
server counts as MCPJam Cloud, and one whose recorded server is not a usable address is refused with exit `3`)\n4. `https://app.mc
pjam.com/api/v1`\n\nEvery command that can contact MCPJam (it accepts `--api-url`, or it uploads results) decides its server when
it starts, before it contacts anything. An explicit `--api-url`, `MCPJAM_API_URL` or `MCPJAM_BASE_URL` that is not an `http(s)` UR
L, or that carries credentials, a query or a fragment, is a usage error (exit `2`), and so are the two variables naming different
servers. The error masks credentials, a query and a fragment, and does not repeat a value that is not a URL. A saved login is only
sent to its own server: when it is the credential and the order picks another server, the command exits `3` before any request. `
mcpjam cloud status` uses the same checks but stays network-free: it still emits the complete JSON report, sets `ok: false`, inclu
des `credential.valid` / `deployment.valid` plus an `error` string, and exits `1`. Missing credentials are informational (`credent
ial.valid: null`) and successful.\n\nSuccessful Cloud commands print an audience line to stderr (`Using MCPJam Cloud as … · projec
t: … · <apiUrl>`). `--quiet` suppresses it. Machine-readable JSON stays on stdout. `cloud status` redacts API keys.\n\n## Cloud pr

oject scope

Most Cloud commands pick one project:

1. `--project <id-or-name>`
2. An explicit `project` field in `--file` /

`--json`
3. `MCPJAM_PROJECT`
4. The nearest valid `.mcpjam/project.json`
5. Automatic — the most recently updated project you c
an see\n\nEmpty `--project` or `MCPJAM_PROJECT` is a usage error. `MCPJAM_PROJECT_ID` does **not** select a Cloud CLI project (it

is SDK eval reporting only).

```bash theme={"theme":"css-variables"}
mcpjam cloud login
mcpjam cloud link
